a_pros: Exceptional video capture quality and audio recording
Powerful A16 Bionic chip with long-term OS support
Seamless integration with the broader Apple ecosystem
a_cons: Display restricted to a 60Hz refresh rate
Lacks a dedicated optical telephoto lens
b_pros: Vibrant 120Hz LTPO display with higher peak brightness
Versatile camera array including a 3x optical telephoto lens
Integrated Galaxy AI features and 7 years of software updates
b_cons: Battery life under heavy usage lags slightly behind iPhone
One UI interface has more pre-installed clutter

metrics.a: Intuitive iOS interface with plug-and-play setup
metrics.b: Highly customizable Android/One UI with a slight learning curve

metrics.label: Key Features
metrics.a: Dynamic Island, 48MP main camera, USB-C, Roadside Assistance via satellite
metrics.b: 120Hz LTPO display, Galaxy AI suite, 3x optical zoom, 7-year update guarantee

metrics.label: Best For
metrics.a: Apple ecosystem users prioritising video recording and simplicity
metrics.b: Users wanting display performance, camera versatility, and AI tools

result.summary: The iPhone 15 and Samsung Galaxy S24 are leading compact flagships with identical entry prices. The Galaxy S24 edges ahead in hardware value with a 120Hz display and dedicated telephoto lens, while the iPhone 15 delivers superior video quality, ecosystem lock-in, and reliable long-term performance. The ideal choice ultimately comes down to operating system preference.
result.best_for: Choosing based on iOS vs. Android platform preference and hardware priorities
